parsed.description: Discard eval-modified run (EVAL_TOKENS cut violates fixed-eval rule); restore EVAL_TOKENS=20971520 and raise MATRIX_LR 0.08 -> 0.10
parsed.report_to_operator: The latest run changed EVAL_TOKENS from 20971520 to 262144, which modifies the fixed evaluation section and makes its val_bpb (1.099894) non-comparable to the ground-truth metric. I discarded it and explicitly restored EVAL_TOKENS=20971520 in the next experiment's config.
